overview_description.description: Weaviate is an open-source, AI-native vector database and agentic platform built for semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and next-generation AI applications. It enables developers to store, index, and query both structured data and high-dimensional vector embeddings, with built-in model integration and hybrid search (vector + keyword) all in one system.

about_short_description.short_description: Weaviate powers semantic search, RAG, and intelligent agents in one AI-native vector database platform

product.name: Weaviate AI Database
product.description: An open-source, AI-native vector database for storing, indexing, and retrieving multimodal data to support semantic search, hybrid search, RAG, and AI agents.

product.name: Weaviate Cloud
product.description: A fully managed cloud service for running Weaviate without operating database infrastructure, available in shared and dedicated deployment models.

product.name: Weaviate Dedicated Cloud
product.description: A fully managed, single-tenant Weaviate deployment that provides isolated infrastructure for predictable performance, security, and enterprise AI workloads.

product.name: Weaviate Shared Cloud
product.description: A fully managed Weaviate database service on shared infrastructure for quickly deploying semantic search, RAG, and AI applications.

product.name: Weaviate Engram
product.description: A managed memory and context service for AI agents that stores and retrieves user-specific information to support personalized, stateful interactions.

product.name: Weaviate Query Agent
product.description: A natural-language query service that translates user questions into database queries and retrieves relevant results from Weaviate collections.
